name: equation-drill
does: An Equations tab over the course's EQUATIONS (a data file listed in course.js `files`): every equation grouped by module, each marked on the sheet, not on it, or one to memorise, opening what each symbol is, when it holds, how to reach it from a printed line and its source; and a writing drill: type the right-hand side (any spelling of the same algebra counts) or build it from pieces, some of them wrong; learned at 3 right in a row.

label.about: the tab's name in the nav

before.about: the tab it is placed before

groups.about: {module number: name} for the module headings; without it, Module <n>
